name: Mori Chatbot
author: mohammadmnd

sections.description:
Turn visitors into buyers with an AI sales assistant that works on your site 24/7.

Mori Chatbot is more than a simple live chat. It acts like an in-store salesperson on your website: it answers shopper questions, recommends the right products, and helps customers decide faster. If your visitors ask questions before buying, compare options, or are unsure which product fits them, Mori is built for exactly that.

Why Mori Chatbot

  • Grows sales by guiding shoppers intelligently
  • Answers pre-sale questions instantly
  • Reduces the load on human support
  • Available 24/7 without interruption
  • Works on any WordPress site
  • Compatible with WooCommerce and product catalogs

Key features

  • Answers based on the real products on your site, not generic replies
  • Sales-focused, not only support: helps with product choice, comparison, and recommendations
  • Fully customizable tone, behavior rules, answer scenarios, and limits
  • Multi-language support for international audiences
  • Fast, code-free setup with just your sharing ID
  • Compatible with all standard WordPress themes
  • Full control over your data and privacy; you can delete your data from the Mori panel at any time

How Mori works (setup in 3 minutes)

  1. Create an AI sales assistant at mori.ir
  2. Set its welcome message, behavior, and rules
  3. Get your own sharing ID
  4. Enter it in the plugin settings in WordPress

External services

This plugin relies on the external Mori service to work.

Chat API: https://api.mori.ir
Used to process chat messages, run the sales-assistant logic, and generate replies based on your settings.

Analytics: https://mori.style/api/wp-event
When the Mori settings page is open in the WordPress dashboard, setup-step events (such as opening the page, verifying a phone number, a step error, and finishing setup) are sent to help improve the setup flow.
What is sent: the event name, the store domain, the plugin version, whether WooCommerce is active, a product-count range (for example “100-999”), the Mori user ID after sign-up, a random ID to follow the setup steps, the step name, an error cause from a fixed list, the setup duration, and the dashboard destination page.
What is not sent: phone number, SMS code, access keys, server error text, and any customer or order data. No request is sent on storefront pages.

By using this plugin you agree to the Mori terms and privacy policy at https://mori.ir/privacy.

Privacy and GDPR

  • Only the messages a user types in the chat are processed
  • No personal data is stored without a direct user action
  • Data for European users is processed in line with GDPR
  • You can fully delete your data from the Mori panel

Full details on Mori’s privacy page: https://mori.ir/privacy

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. See https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html for more information.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to the Mori Chatbot settings in the WordPress dashboard
  3. Enter your sharing ID
  4. Done, the assistant is active
sections.faq:
Is Mori just a regular chatbot?

No. Mori is an AI sales assistant focused on pre-sale guidance and growing sales.

Do I need technical knowledge to use it?

No. No coding is required.

Is Mori free to use?

Creating an AI sales assistant starts free. Plan details are at https://mori.ir/pricing.

What data is stored?

Only chat messages are processed to generate replies. You fully control data deletion.

Is it compatible with my theme?

Yes, it works with all standard WordPress themes.

Does Mori change my site pages?

Only when you ask and approve it in a conversation with the Mori store assistant: the text of a published page (with or without Elementor), a picture of an Elementor page (the new picture is added to your media library and the old one stays there), or moving it to trash and restoring it. This uses the same WooCommerce key the plugin created when connecting. No page is permanently deleted, and the home page and WooCommerce pages are not sent to trash.

Does Mori publish posts on my blog?

Only when you ask and approve it in a conversation with the Mori store assistant, and only as a draft: the post is created in the Posts section and is not visible on the site until you publish it yourself in WordPress.

  • Release version 3.7.7

  • The Mori shop assistant can swap a picture on an Elementor page (a picture, a background or a slide), only after the site owner approves that exact change. The new picture goes into the media library, the old one stays there, and the page cache of WP Rocket is cleared for that page

3.7.6

  • The Mori shop assistant can read the daily visitors and views that WP Statistics counts on this site, to answer the owner

3.7.5

  • The Mori shop assistant can update, switch off, switch on or delete one other plugin, only after the site owner approves that exact step. Updates use only the version WordPress itself offers; WooCommerce and Mori Chatbot are never switched off or deleted, nor a plugin that other active plugins need
